title: Order autofill & sizing
description: Defaults the order ticket prefills entry/stop/target/size from. Every value is editable per-order; these set the starting point.

riskMode.title: Risk mode
riskMode.description: How the per-trade risk budget is set: a fraction of account equity, or a fixed dollar amount.

riskFraction.title: Risk per trade (fraction of equity)
riskFraction.description: 0.005 = 0.5% of equity risked per trade (used when risk mode = fraction_of_equity). Capped at 2% — live-safety discipline on the always-on MANUAL lane.

riskUsd.title: Risk per trade ($)
riskUsd.description: Fixed dollar risk per trade (used when risk mode = fixed_usd).

maxPositionFraction.title: Max position (fraction of equity)
maxPositionFraction.description: Cap a single position's notional at this fraction of equity (0.1 = 10%).

atrMult.title: ATR stop multiple
atrMult.description: ATR-based stop distance = this × ATR from entry.

targetR.title: Target (R multiple)
targetR.description: Take-profit distance as a multiple of risk (entry→stop).

maxSpreadPct.title: Max spread for mid entry
maxSpreadPct.description: Refuse a mid-price entry when the quote spread exceeds this fraction (IEX quotes run wide).
